'''Bloodhound''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] member of [[Paxton Rall]]'s crew. When Paxton was persuaded by [[Alliance Commander]] to join the [[Eternal Alliance]], Bloodhound followed suit and joined as well.<ref>{{TORcite|type=general|Privateer Enlistment|Odessen}}</ref>
